name: What is the difference between interior painting and interior finishing?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between interior painting and interior finishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior painting primarily involves applying paint to walls, ceilings, trim, and doors for aesthetic and protective purposes. Interior finishing is a broader term that encompasses all final treatments applied to interior surfaces, which can include painting, but also extends to staining, varnishing, and other decorative or protective coatings for wood, plaster, or other materials. Our services can cover both aspects depending on your project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior painting is applying paint; interior finishing is a broader term including painting, staining, and varnishing surfaces.
